verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a distinct Transactional API/message type for receipts, password resets, etc. (customer-io-docs-14, customer-io-docs-25, customer-io-docs-23), separate from broadcast/journey sends, but there is no explicit documentation that transactional sends bypass unsubscribe/suppression status or that transactional sending reputation is isolated from marketing reputation. Missing for 10: explicit statement that suppressed/unsubscribed marketing contacts still receive transactional messages, and detail on separate IP/domain reputation pools for transactional vs marketing.
